statusHistory.note: Ad-hoc chat request per BACKLOG.md's Porto priority bump (ahead of Berlin) — Near's first Porto pin. Deliberately avoided Livraria Lello (the famous/touristy pick) in favor of Gato Vadio, a self-described 'Livraria · Café-Bar · Associação Cultural' at Rua da Maternidade 124, 4050-369 Porto. Verified via the shop's own blog (gatovadiolivraria.blogspot.com): founded 2007 as a poetry/politics/anarchist-leaning independent bookshop and space of 'resistance, culture and social intervention'; survived a near-closure by converting into a non-profit cultural association in 2011 (per ReLI and Radical Guide); evicted from its original address in 2019 amid Porto gentrification and relocated ~50m away to the current Rua da Maternidade address, reopening after renovation in March 2020 (Time Out Porto). Current hours per the blog: Tuesday-Saturday 3pm-7pm, plus evenings when there's a scheduled event. The blog's own event log shows an active, ongoing program through mid/late 2026 (an AI-and-society discussion 30 July 2026; an ecosocialist network debate 22 July 2026; a meeting with Filipino-Canadian writer Paulina Constancia 15 July 2026; an Amazonia-queer documentary screening 26 June 2026; a 'Reencantar o Mundo' presentation/debate 23 August 2026) — all now in the past relative to today, so no single forward-dated event is used as the hook; the pattern of frequent programming is described honestly as ongoing rather than invented as a specific future date. No September/October 2026 listing could be confirmed via Facebook or web search at time of writing — flagged as a gap for a follow-up pass once the shop posts its autumn calendar. Hero image: no rights-clear photo of the actual Gato Vadio shopfront turned up on Wikimedia Commons; used a CC BY-SA 4.0 photo of Rua da Maternidade itself (the same street, showing the Palacete Pinto Leite portico) instead of leaving the piece imageless or generating an illustration, per the operator's 2026-09-01 real-photo-over-limbo policy — disclosed honestly in licenseNote. Coordinates are a manual approximation for the Cedofeita/central-Porto area around Rua da Maternidade (confidence 0.5); an exact geocode of no. 124 is still owed as follow-up. Filed as trust: auto and status: draft per the operator's explicit direction for this piece; holding as draft pending the operator's own review before it goes live, since this is Near's very first Porto page and worth a human look before publishing to a brand-new city.
